name: MedOrbits Cloudflare Response Header Rules

deployment.dashboard: Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Header

rules.name: MEDORBITS-SECURITY-FRAME-OPTIONS
rules.description: Restrict framing to the same origin.

rules.name: MEDORBITS-SECURITY-HSTS
rules.description: Enable HSTS only after HTTPS and subdomain review.

rules.name: MEDORBITS-CSP-REPORT-ONLY
rules.description: Initial CSP monitoring policy. Validate application dependencies before deployment.

deployment_checks: Confirm hostname expressions match the intended production domains.
Check existing origin headers to avoid duplicate or conflicting values.
Test the website and API after each rule is enabled.
Keep HSTS disabled until HTTPS coverage is verified.
Test CSP in report-only mode before enforcing it.
Keep CORS configuration at the application or API layer.
Maintain a rollback record before production changes.
important: This is a project configuration reference, not Cloudflare's API import format.
Create each rule manually in the Cloudflare dashboard or convert it using a separately validated API workflow.
Do not deploy all rules blindly.
